full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a sagittal section of a vertebral column segment. The cut surface reveals multiple vertebral bodies separated by intervertebral discs. Several of the vertebral bodies exhibit distinct focal fibrotic or neoplastic lesions, while other regions of the bone marrow appear relatively preserved. The macroscopic appearance demonstrates structural involvement of the spine by disease processes such as localized fibrosis or neoplasm.
